unresolvedReferences.reason: family index only; the 8 unit records live in separate candidate files daikin-fdxm{25,35,50,60}f9-indoor.json and daikin-rxm-fdxm{25,35,50,60}f9-outdoor.json; page-50 coverage: 4 indoor (25F9/35F9/50F9/60F9) + 4 outdoor (25R9/35R9/50R/60R). Pairings 25F9+25R / 35F9+35R / 50F9+50R / 60F9+60R are MONOSPLIT efficiency-table columns; NO 'Connexion multi uniquement' band on p.50. NOTE outdoor table column headers '25R9/35R9' but efficiency pairing suffix 'R' (25F9+25R) -> suffix ambiguity (R vs R9) flagged, model reference kept per efficiency pairing, no invented suffix. CRITICAL: p.50 efficiency table has NO 'Puissance absorbée' (electrical input) row -> electrical input UNKNOWN for ALL FDXM-F9 pairings (not invented). Efficiency table publishes Mini./Nom./Maxi. thermal only. Indoor airflow published m3/min (x60 -> m3/h), labels Bas/Moyen/Haut (NO Silence speed); cooling and heating airflow identical. Indoor external static pressure: 30 Pa (25F9/35F9 merged), 40 Pa (50F9/60F9 merged). Indoor sound power (25F9/35F9 merged 53,0; 50F9 55,0; 60F9 56,0); indoor sound pressure Bas/Haut (25F9/35F9 27,0/35,0; 50F9/60F9 30,0/38,0). Indoor dims 25F9/35F9 200x750x620 mass 21; 50F9/60F9 200x1.150x620 (1150mm) mass 28. Outdoor dims 25R9/35R9 550x765x285 mass 32; 50R/60R 734x870x373 mass 49,0. Outdoor sound power cool (58/61/62,0/63,0) heat (59/61/62,0/63,0); outdoor sound pressure cool (46/49/48,0/48,0) heat (47/49/49,0/49,0). CROSS-PAGE DIMENSION CONFLICT: p.50 RXM50R/60R dims 734x870x373 DIFFER from p.43/p.48/p.49 RXM50R/60R dims 734x954x401 -> likely DIFFERENT physical outdoor unit; p.50 values kept SEPARATE (daikin-rxm-fdxm50f9-outdoor.json / daikin-rxm-fdxm60f9-outdoor.json) from p.43 (daikin-rxm50r/rxm60r-outdoor.json) and p.48/p.49 (daikin-rxm-cvxm50a / daikin-rxm-fvxm50f), NOT merged. p.50 operating cool -10~46 heat -15~24. precharged 10m (25R9/35R9 only; 50R/60R cell '-'); charge suppl 0,02>10m; pipe 6,35 liquid all, gas 9,50 (25R9/35R9) / 12,7 (50R/60R); longueur 20/30; dénivelé 15/20,0; MFA 13 (25R9/35R9) / 16 (50R/60R). PRP cell 675 (25R9/35R9) vs 675,0 (50R/60R) formatting diff. Page blurb 'Gamme unifiée d'unités intérieures pour un fonctionnement avec le R-32 et le R-410A' = refrigerant compatibility marketing claim, not a pairing. Outdoor airflow, fan motor power, outdoor-only electrical boundary, maximumBranchPipeLength, current 2026 availability all unresolved.
